title: Manga 'Witch Watch' Concludes Serialization
content: Kenta Shinohara 's Witch Watch manga has concluded with chapter 270 in the 51st issue of Weekly Shounen Jump magazine on Monday, after a five-year serialization. Shinohara began serializing the supernatural comedy manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in February 2021. Shueisha published the 28th volume on October 2.
